theme: Dark Mode primary with Light Mode toggle (The 'Swiss Brutalist' Tech/Art fusion)

typography.headings: Syne or Oswald (High impact, wide, heavy sans for editorial feel). Use tracking-tighter for H1.
typography.body: DM Sans or Manrope (Clean, highly readable geometric sans).

rules.H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ with tracking-tighter, NEVER centered by default.
rules.alignment: Left-align dense text and headings for editorial flow. Break the center-everything disease.

visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis smooth scroll (momentum scrolling). Framer Motion for masked line-by-line text reveals (clip-path or overflow-hidden wrapper with y-axis translate). Parallax hero imagery.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky nav (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10). Solid flat backgrounds for CMS dashboard.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Magnetic custom cursor effect on interactive elements. Scroll-triggered fade/slide ups for sections.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) to define grid areas, embracing the 'Technical Skeleton' look.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: MODE A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetric, bold, high tension. Use massive column spans combined with negative space (e.g., col-span-8 next to empty col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.cms_dashboard: MODE B (High Density). Functional, dense grid. Cardless UI with sharp edges or very subtle rounding (max 4px). Focus on readability and hierarchy.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more padding than usual (p-12, p-16, py-32 for sections) on marketing pages.

component_instructions.hero: Kinetic text with masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. Keep background imagery dark/moody (overlay max bg-black/50) to let text pop.
component_instructions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, editorial pace. Low contrast or massive outline text running behind content.
component_instructions.contact_form: Multi-step lead qualification using Framer Motion (AnimatePresence). Shadcn base but highly customized to remove the 'default template' feel.
component_instructions.whatsapp_button: Floating action button, bottom right. Keep it distinct but integrated with brand colors (maybe stark white/black with WhatsApp green hover).
component_instructions.cms_dashboard: Admin only (Protected route). Tabular layouts, clear typography, highly functional, no fluffy gradients.
component_instructions.blog_cms: Public visitors see beautiful editorial grid of posts. Admin needs login to access CRUD operations.

marketing_analytics.description: laptop with premium marketing analytics dashboard (use for case studies/results)

media.rules: Never use placeholder images (via.placeholder.com etc). Use provided images. Ensure text contrast over images via overlays.

content_guidance.case_studies: Since it's a startup, generate 3 hyper-realistic placeholder case studies with measurable results (e.g., '+140% ROAS for FinTech Client').
content_guidance.team: Generate realistic personas for the leadership team.
content_guidance.services: List 19 services including Neuromarketing, SEO, Performance Marketing, etc.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain APCA / WCAG AA minimums. Dark text on light background or vice versa.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install critical dependencies: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react sonner
Configure Tailwind with the provided Obsidian/Vermilion color palette.
Use JavaScript (.js or .jsx) strictly, not TypeScript.
Construct the multi-step contact form mimicking a Calendly flow but entirely integrated using Framer Motion.
Set up a global search UI (command-K style or full-screen overlay).
Create the authentication context: /admin requires login, public routes do not.
Integrate Resend for newsletter and contact form API endpoints.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .jsx).
